{
  "gateway": "dv360_native_action",
  "mode": "direct",
  "description": "Execute any Display & Video 360 v4 REST action from the generated docs-backed catalog. Use canonical DV360_* actions such as DV360_ADVERTISERS_LIST, or resource + method such as resource=advertisers and method=list. Pass path/query parameters through params, pathParams, or query; pass create/update request bodies through body or payload. body/payload may also be nested under params and may be a JSON object or a stringified JSON object. Campaign flow: create the paused campaign shell with create_campaign or DV360_ADVERTISERS_CAMPAIGNS_CREATE, create the insertion order with DV360_ADVERTISERS_INSERTION_ORDERS_CREATE, create display/video/audio/Demand Gen or explicit YouTube & Partners line items with create_adset or DV360_ADVERTISERS_LINE_ITEMS_CREATE, then upload/create/assign creatives before activating. For YouTube & Partners line item writes, provide the exact lineItemType and bidStrategy.youtubeAndPartnersBid. Existing DV360 accounts can return YouTube & Partners line items through read/list, so MCP does not locally block explicit payloads; Google remains the final authority for account/type-specific write support. For creative assets use DV360_ADVERTISERS_ASSETS_UPLOAD with advertiserId plus body/payload { filename, mediaBase64 or mediaContent, mimeType }. For generic media upload use DV360_MEDIA_UPLOAD with resourceName plus mediaBase64 or mediaContent and mimeType; the backend adds upload_type=media. For generic media download use DV360_MEDIA_DOWNLOAD with resourceName; the backend adds alt=media. For creative creation use DV360_ADVERTISERS_CREATIVES_CREATE or the semantic create_creative tool, then assign creatives by patching DV360_ADVERTISERS_LINE_ITEMS_PATCH with updateMask=creativeIds. For YouTube line item asset launch work, manage location lists with DV360_ADVERTISERS_LOCATION_LISTS_* and link sitelink/location assets with DV360_ADVERTISERS_LINE_ITEMS_YOUTUBE_ASSET_TYPES_YOUTUBE_ASSET_ASSOCIATIONS_*; Google marks association create/delete as available only to an informed subset of users. For location/POI/business-chain lookup, use DV360_TARGETING_TYPES_TARGETING_OPTIONS_SEARCH with targetingType plus advertiserId and body aliases such as searchTerms/query; MCP normalizes them to geoRegionSearchTerms.geoRegionQuery, poiSearchTerms.poiQuery, or businessChainSearchTerms.businessChainQuery. Do not guess geo targetingOptionId values. For interests/audiences such as cars, do not use targetingOptions.search. Use DV360_GOOGLE_AUDIENCES_LIST, DV360_CUSTOM_LISTS_LIST, DV360_COMBINED_AUDIENCES_LIST, and/or DV360_FIRST_PARTY_AND_PARTNER_AUDIENCES_LIST with advertiserId or partnerId and query/searchTerms/displayName; MCP normalizes those aliases to the documented displayName filter. Target selected results with TARGETING_TYPE_AUDIENCE_GROUP via audienceGroupDetails. For channels and inventory/deal discovery, use DV360_ADVERTISERS_CHANNELS_LIST, DV360_PARTNERS_CHANNELS_LIST, DV360_INVENTORY_SOURCES_LIST, or DV360_INVENTORY_SOURCE_GROUPS_LIST with query/searchTerms/displayName; MCP normalizes supported displayName filters. For finite targeting taxonomies such as categories, devices, browsers, languages, and exchanges, use DV360_TARGETING_TYPES_TARGETING_OPTIONS_LIST and filter returned names client-side unless the docs expose a server filter. For Bid Manager reports, standard report runs, query runs, report retrieval, or report listing, use dv360_reporting_ops instead of this generic REST tool. Write actions default to dry_run: true and require confirmed: true when dry_run is false.",
